data.name: Herzog
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German words 'heriz' (army) and 'zog' (duke). The name Herzog translates to 'army leader' or 'duke'. This name was used for the leaders of smaller territories in medieval Europe.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing leadership, courage, and strength.

Its royal and noble origins have also made it a popular surname among many European families with noble lineages.

Ultimately, the name Herzog can inspire us to be strong leaders in our own lives, whether that be as parents, community leaders, or in our personal relationships.
